name: the-tryline-app
description: The Tryline — customer ordering app (Capacitor wrapper around the web app)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
